annotations.title: Get the guests' answers to a calendar event

description:
See how the guests answered a calendar event: going, not going or maybe.

Only works on a calendar event; any other message answers
`invalid_request: message_not_calendar`.

The answer has `counts` (how many guests are going, not going or
maybe, and how many extra guests those who are going or maybe are
bringing) and `responses`, one entry per guest with who they are, their
answer, any extra guests they bring and when they answered. A guest who
changes their mind leaves one entry showing the latest answer, so this
is a current snapshot and not a history. To be told as answers come in,
watch for `message.calendar_responded` with `list_events`.

An event nobody has answered yet returns zero counts and an empty list,
which is the normal answer and not an error.
